session_covered: US and European sessions of Thursday 15 October
intro: Covers the US and European sessions of Thursday 15 October. Gold and Brent are CFD/reference prints with small cross-source differences (see notes).
footnotes: Gold: FNArena US$4,173.22 (+1.75%), Trading Economics US$4,171.06 (+1.60%); the latter is shown. Brent: Trading Economics US$105.73 (-0.31%); FNArena figure shown. Yield: Trading Economics shows about 5.07%; Yahoo Finance/FNArena 5.09% shown. Iron ore and AUD/USD are single-source (FNArena).

setup.summary: SPI 200 futures are at 8,844, up 1.06% (FNArena and TradingView agree). Applied to the prior ASX 200 cash close of 8,719.70 (-0.09% on Thursday), that implies an open near 8,812, up about 92 points or 1.06%.

local_events: Australian September labour force data from the ABS (consensus not available).
Company results: not confirmed (FNArena's calendar is paywalled).
what_moved: Treasuries rallied despite hot US inflation data: the 10-year yield fell about 10 bp to 5.09% and the Dow rose 1.08%, led by defensive and rate-sensitive areas. Consumer staples led the large-cap sectors with a gain of more than 2% and homebuilders rallied, while technology and semiconductors remained weak on worries about debt-funded AI spending; chip stocks fell for a seventh straight session. US producer prices (PPI) rose 1.3% in September and CPI was also above forecasts, keeping a further Fed rate rise in play.

news.headline: US PPI jumps 1.3%.
news.summary: September wholesale prices posted their largest monthly rise since March 2022.

news.headline: Hot CPI lifts Fed-hike odds.
news.summary: September CPI rose 0.6% m/m and 3.7% y/y (3.6% expected); markets priced roughly a 40% chance of an October hike.

news.headline: Bond rally.
news.summary: The 10-year yield fell to 5.09% and the 30-year to 5.43% as investors sought safety from the AI-linked tech sell-off.

news.headline: AI financing stress.
news.summary: CoreWeave's credit default swaps hit a record and South Korea's KOSPI fell about 7% as the global chip sell-off continued.

news.headline: Oil stays elevated.
news.summary: Brent held near US$105.8/bbl, with traders weighing Middle East supply risks.

news.headline: ASX closes slightly lower.
news.summary: The ASX 200 fell 0.09% to 8,719.70 on Thursday; banks gained 2.92% while materials fell 3.95%.

coming_up: The next FOMC meeting is 27-28 October 2026 (no projections); US midterm elections follow on 3 November.
